description: Synchronized Traffic Signal Corridors is a dataset listed in City of Austin open data portal (datahub.austintexas.gov), an open data portal (Socrata) of a city, published or maintained by City of Austin. This dataset is under active development and is subject to change at any time This dataset contains information on the individual signals that synchronized to a larger corridor. This product is for informational purposes and may not have been prepared for or be suitable for legal, engineering, or surveying purposes. Coverage: Austin. The portal files it under the category Transportation and Mobility. Its tags are transit, traffic signals, transportation, mobility, retiming. The table has 16 columns. Attribution on the portal: City of Austin, Texas - data.austintexas.gov. The portal shows 2023-01-17 as the last data update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is public domain (as labelled on the portal). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-soc-datahub-austintexas-gov-portal.
